title: llms.txt
content: llms.txt is a proposed website file for giving AI agents a concise description of a site and pointers to useful resources.

meta.why: A maintained resource map may help a compatible tool navigate documentation, although helping a tool navigate is a separate claim from improving search visibility.
meta.example: A software documentation site supplies a short overview and links to installation, authentication, and API references.
meta.check: Identify the intended consumer and confirm that it uses the file before investing in an ongoing maintenance process.
meta.limitation: llms.txt is a proposal with no power to control access, and Google says its AI search features require no new AI text file.
meta.sources:
Jeremy Howard: the llms.txt proposal | https://llmstxt.org/ | Proposal
Google Search Central: AI features and your website | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features | Platform documentation
